notes.title: [Developer’s Note #38] The Enigmatic Girl.
notes.content:
Hello, this is the 213℉ development team.

Continuing our series of character features from TSURUGIHIME, we are proud to present another central figure in the story—accompanied by a brand-new illustration by KUROBOSHI KOUHAKU.

This time, we focus on a mysterious girl who keeps her face hidden beneath a hood—Bouquet Flowerlessgarden.

Enjoy a glimpse into her daily life!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/a3033a823b8418f7307e058000d9b6a61536be0d.png[/img]
She can sleep anytime, anywhere. Literally, time and place don’t seem to matter.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/ac7491b6f05f3d80ad110de35996ec0bc6d548c4.png[/img]
If danger approaches, she reacts instantly. Her skills as a Tsurugi wielder are beyond question.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/1462b91fd721df16d1afd26524e2f673b3b672ca.png[/img]
If something catches her attention, she can’t help but speak to it. Even if it’s clearly something that can’t talk back.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/612cc5b0b2b6fd4330f66421ce2a520ebcfff1bf.png[/img]
She raises her hand toward the sky. What is she reaching for?



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/34b7c217b5381beb3c2aec2f77aa0aa956f7dc8c.png[/img]
What did you think of Bouquet’s everyday life before the tournament? Mysterious and unpredictable, what kind of clash awaits between her and our protagonist, Arche?

We hope you’re enjoying the gradual reveal of our cast of characters.

With this, our series on Arche’s rivals comes to a close. Starting next time, we’ll return with development updates and new behind-the-scenes content!

For the latest news on TSURUGIHIME, follow our Developer’s Notes. And please don’t forget to add to your Wishlist!

notes.title: Notice of Release Delay
notes.content:
To all those who have been waiting for the release of “TSURUGIHIME,”


Thank you very much for adding “TSURUGIHIME” to your Wishlist and following our store updates. Also, thank you for all the likes and comments on the “Developer's Note”. Each and every one of your responses encourages our development team everyday. Thank you again.


Today, we would like to make an important announcement.


We have decided to postpone the release of “TSURUGIHIME” in order to further improve the quality of the game, which we were planning to release within 2024.


Based on the feedback we have received since the announcement of the 2022 release, we felt the need to deliver a more complete and refined game experience to everyone, and we have decided that it is essential to deliver the game in a state that is even better than originally planned. We deeply regret having to make this announcement as we approach the end of 2024, the year originally planned for the release of "TSURUGIHIME." We sincerely apologize to everyone who has been looking forward to its launch.


Since the announcement of “TSURUGIHIME”, we have continued to develop the game with a small team. This will not change in the future. We will continue to develop “TSURUGIHIME” step by step but steadily.

We will continue to develop the characters drawn by KUROBOSHI KOHAKU, the music played by Takeharu Ishimoto, and we will do our utmost to deliver the unique game experience through the “an RPG that crafts fate,” as soon as possible.

We will keep you updated on our daily progress in the “Developer's Note” section, so please continue to follow us as always. We will also announce new release dates as soon as details are finalized.

We hope for you continued support and again, thank you very much.


From the entire “TSURUGIHIME” development team.

notes.title: [Developer's Note #30] 7 Tsurugi wielders.
notes.content:
Hello, this is the 213℉ Development Team.

We have introduced you to the 7 main characters designed by KUROBOSHI KOUHAKU over the past several issues. Let's take a look back again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/ed442621b5a79bc8b940ee7964ddd10c84509b90.png[/img]
The protagonist of TSURUGIHIME is Arche A. Pleides, a genius swordsman, one of a kind in 1,000 years.

Momiji Mizumura Gentosai is the one and only best friend of Arche.

Farfrost LunaFilleigh, who fights on the back of a prestigious family's expectations.

Eurydia Von Valhllaheart, who represents her country and is entrusted with the fate of her nation.

Yuno, a girl seeking her own origin in the tournament.

Zeusix XIII, the girl who threw herself into the battle to save lives.

And Bouquet FlowerlessGarden, an unidentified, deeply hooded wielder of a sword.


The story of TSURUGIHIME spins around these seven girls. Each of them has a different personality, but here is what I want you to pay attention to!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/d6e76525c4e4a87f0589af60a71f51ca12e89c80.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43295254/1f17ab21b29ff427330b9f71fc1c8a6182840052.png[/img]
An imprint, which gives the impression of a connection to the obtained item in one's hand, appears somewhere on the body on the day one becomes a Tsurugi wielder.

Here we have introduced 7 imprints, but perhaps there are other Tsurugi wielders out there. The story of that is for another time!


And what a surprise, this issue of News has now reached its 30th installment! We have continued to this point in order to bring you as much of the charm of this work as possible, but we hope you have been enjoying it. We hope you are enjoying it. Please let us know what you think, what you would like to know, what you would like to request, and anything else you would like to know, and we would be happy to hear your opinions in the comments!


So far, we have introduced the 7 Tsurugi wielders, the main characters of TSURUGIHIME, in several articles. We will bring you more information in the next issue, so please follow us and add to your Wishlist!

TSURUGIHIME, an RPG that "crafts" fate.

TSURUGIHIME, scheduled for release in 2024, is still in the early stages of development. We will be sharing information with you as we create the game, and we hope that you will enjoy the live experience of its development as well.

Well, the first thing I want to introduce to you all in these Developer's Note is the main character of TSURUGIHIME! She is..., but she does not have a name yet. One of the hooks of TSURUGIHIME is that you can enjoy the various appearances of the characters designed by KUROBOSHI KOUHAKU.
